blocks.text: The module documentation defines the fixed system guidance, plan-mode addition, history shapes, assembler contract, and boundaries that belong to later context-management patches.
blocks.title: Prompt and assembler contract

blocks.anchor: "smallest change that does the job, and match the surrounding code's style, naming and comment density. "
blocks.text: SYSTEM_PROMPT and PLAN_MODE_ADDITION contain server-authored guidance about tools, denials, data versus instructions, and plan mode; system_prompt selects the mode-specific text.
blocks.title: Fixed prompt text

blocks.text: AssembledContext normalizes messages, tools, and notes to tuples. ContextAssembler defines the seam, while call_assembler awaits async implementations and rejects the wrong result type.
blocks.title: Assembler interface

blocks.text: Tool output is converted to text, prefixed when unsuccessful, and annotated when truncated. _calls_of turns protocol tool-call records into ToolCall objects.
blocks.title: Tool history conversion

blocks.text: Validated user, assistant, and tool history entries become model messages; entries outside the expected shape are ignored.
blocks.title: Conversation conversion

blocks.text: DefaultContextAssembler orders system prompt, project instructions, rules, memory index, and converted conversation, then returns the visible tools without budgeting.
blocks.title: Default context assembly

gotchas: Malformed history items are skipped rather than inferred.
The default assembler performs no token budgeting or compaction.
Tool output is marked as an error when ok is false.
how_it_works: Builds ask or plan system prompts
purpose: This module keeps product guidance and context assembly out of the model loop. It converts validated history items into model messages, preserves tool metadata, supports sync or async assembler implementations, and provides a no-budget default assembler for earlier loop versions.
summary: Defines the coding-agent system prompt and a simple conversation-to-model context assembler.

symbols.summary: Immutable container for model messages, tools, provider options, token limits, and assembler notes.
Defines the synchronous or asynchronous assemble hook consumed by the model loop.
Invokes an assembler, awaits it when needed, and enforces the AssembledContext return type.
Formats a tool history item's output with error and truncation markers.
Converts assistant tool-call mappings into ToolCall records.
Maps validated conversation items to model Message objects in original order.
Provides the simple pre-budgeting context assembler used by the initial agent loop.
